beats.care: Drought means smaller harvests, which can push up prices of rice, vegetables and pulses. Save water at home, it matters more this year.
beats.what: Andhra Pradesh declared 388 mandals in 21 districts drought-hit. Telangana's chief minister meets ministers on 12 October about drought there too.
beats.why: AP got about half its normal rain from June to August. Officials link the weak monsoon to El Niño, a warming of the Pacific Ocean.

cards.body: Of AP's 388 drought mandals, 283 are severely hit. It got 197.6 mm of rain since 1 June against a normal 424.3 mm. Telangana is 17% short on rain and has asked the Centre for a ₹20,000 crore package.

Every few years, the Pacific Ocean near South America gets unusually warm. That shifts winds and rain patterns around the world, and in India it often means a weaker monsoon. Its opposite, La Niña, usually brings more rain.
cards.title: what is el niño?

cards.body: An official declaration unlocks relief, like help for farmers who lost crops and money from the Centre. That's why Telangana's Assembly asked the Centre to declare its dry mandals drought-affected.
cards.title: why 'declare' a drought?

cards.body: AP declared drought weeks early. Its drought manual normally waits until 31 October, but the rain gap was too big to wait.
